title: Make the issue search honour the fields left blank

blocks.text: The issue tracker's search form has an assignee field, a minimum priority and a row of label boxes. An issue is found when it meets every field the user filled in; for the labels, carrying any one of the ticked labels is enough. The service builds one `Predicate<Issue>` per filled-in field and combines them in `matching(...)`.

items: `allOf(...)`: one predicate that holds when every criterion in the list holds;
`anyLabel(...)`: one predicate that holds when an issue carries at least one of the labels;

blocks.text: Users search with every combination of blank and filled-in fields, the completely blank form included, which they use to see the whole board. About six lines in total.

cases.says: with assignee, minimum priority and one label filled in, only issues meeting all three are found
with a minimum priority and one label, only issues meeting both are found
a form with nothing filled in lists every issue
a form with no label ticked does not filter on labels
with several labels ticked, an issue carrying any one of them is found

origin.section: Optional Criteria Reduce from the Operator's Identity: x -> true for and, x -> false for or

concepts: An optional criterion whose field is empty is left out rather than reduced, because the or-reduction of nothing is x -> false and empties the result.
Reducing a list of predicates starts from x -> true for and and from x -> false for or; the other identity, or orElse(x -> false) on an empty list, rejects or accepts everything.
